title: Inspect container details
summary: inspect returns detailed configuration and state. A format expression can select a small part of the result.
introduction: inspect returns detailed configuration and state. A format expression can select a small part of the result. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: inspect returns detailed configuration and state. A format expression can select a small part of the result.
The result describes the container state, such as running. It depends on the current container.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare the full inspect output with the selected field.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Inspect only containers you own or have permission to examine.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).
